notes.title: Update 1.7.6 additional fixes and changes
notes.notes:
Fixes :
- Fix the grass rendering in the rover mode and storm the ares, Now shouldn't be rendered white or missing

Changes: 
- Rover now uses a rigid body as a simulation instead of raytracing. This will help detects the environment better.
- All prerendered textures for BOINC, antenna animations, etc. are implemented in the game. With this technique the CPU usage will be decreased, especially using the BOINC. The only downfall will be the increased loading time before starting a new game ( as some of you have already found ).

notes.title: Update 1.7.6 small update
notes.notes:
Fix: 


 When using the VHS, the game starts filling the log file with thousands of unnecessary logs.
 Vegetation scale in distance


Optimizations:
In the old version the monitor antennas, planets when you detect signals and other animated monitor images were rendered in realtime as textures increasing the CPU usage. I have started to prerender some of the animations as separate textures, removing the camera rendering. The downside of this is a little more Ram usage and loading time, but this will decrease the CPU usage. In the next few weeks expect updates that will replace the old system.

Changes:

 Sun shafts are now connected with the fog
 Fog and Sun Shaft resolution is connected to volumetric effects. In 1.7.1 the fog resolution was around Medium, so High and Ultra can cause you a FPS drop


IMPORTANT

- If you have a high CPU usage you can lock you FPS in graphic option to 30 or 60 fps. This will reduce the calculation per second and will reduce your CPU usage. High end CPUs shouldn't have any problems.

notes.title: 1.7 Update - fixes and changes
notes.notes:
- Lights with realtime shadows will now generate shadows only when the player is in close to the light source. This will reduce the shadow casters and improving the performance. Sun light stays the same as before.
- Volumetric fog resolution reduced - improving the performance.
- Sitting on the desk will disable most of the game objects to reduce unnecessary calculations, it will also disable all the shadows except the sun and the light over the desk.
- Displays with animated textures like Weather App, Boinc, Outdoor Camera , etc will render only when necessary. When you are outside they will be fully disabled.
- Graphic Option for animated textures setting the animation framerate.
- Smaller rocks around the terrain except the bigger ones will not affect the Cart speed anymore.
- In case you are close to the Cart respawn point, the respawn coordinates will change, so it won't respawn on your head anymore :)
- Cart will now detects if it is under the terrain (Just in case something breaks) and will automatically respawn to the respawn point.

notes.notes:
CHANGES AND IMPROVEMENTS

 New sound when walking on the snow
 Improved Loading Screen

 Observatory audio will be muted outside the observatory.

New antenna models

- SCANNING

 Changes the way a signal was generated. Now when scanning an anomaly will show on an improvised map, detected this map will gives you and anomaly to detect. Once analyzed it will generate a trash signal, or a normal signal to detect with the antennas. The chance of a signal to be generated is 33%. Now you won't need to wait for a signal, but you will have to work a little to get one.


- ANTENNA CALIBRATION

When the azimuth or elevation calibration error is more than 10 or lower than -10 you will need to calibrate the antenna or the antenna detection will drop with -5%. To do that set the Antena Azimuth to 0 and go to the upper platform of the antenna. There you will find a Calibration control panel. Set the azimuth and evevation close to 0 and press calibrate button. This will calibrate the antenna.
Calibratio error is generated while the antenna is movind.


 Calibration Control on every antenna
 Generate Calibration Error when antenna moves
 Set Calibration Penalty for antenna detection if calibration error is more than 10 or less than -10
 New calibration control panel placed on the upper antenna platform - Use it to calibrate the antenna if needed.

 Thunders and lightnings when raining

notes.title: Update 1.0.1.3
notes.notes:
- Main Building improvement, mostly textures, UV mapping , etc.
- Reset button for the key binds in Options > Controls , you can now reset key configuration back to default.
- You can use Secondary mouse button to Zoom In and Out while sitting.
- Fix: Gravity of the player controller tweaked, this should prevent you from floating when moving through stairs and other elevated areas
- Fix: Upgrade system text is changed to MAXED when you upgrade to lv 5, there is no point to shows you science point if you can't upgrade it further.
- Fix: Using the upgrade system previously loads also the antenna coordinates, this creates a jumps while moving the antenna and can cause exploits or slower the rotation. Now it loads properly as expected.
- Fix: Mouse rotation smooth tweaked. Now mouse sensitivity should be more responsive
- And some more preparations for the next big update, that are hidden for now :)

Thank you for the feedback !

notes.title: Update 1.0.1.2
notes.notes:
- In rare cases binary numbers when detecting and tracing signal duplicate and exit the screen, i still investigate the problem. I have rewrote the algorithm that turns the string into binary text, it is possible to fix it, but it is a random event so it is difficult to say.

- In some rare cases the mouse is floating in a direction without touching it. I have made some small changes. I really don't know if this is a hardware or a game problem. I will test it further with different hardware.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

This is a small update based on your feedbacks. It is not a big one just some small features, tweaks and fixes. I will continue to develop according to plan, meanwhile i will follow you feedbacks and try to add everything you need as soon as possible.

- Buttons to disable download signal audio as requested
- Buttons to disable signal detection audio as requested
- Lowered the sound of the footsteps with 60% as requested
- Added Invert Y-Axis for the mouse in options > controls as requested
- Decreased signal generation time, now it will appear a little faster than before.
- Fixed : Тhe number of letters per line is doubled when decoding signal. This will prevent them to be cut from the borders of the monitor in some cases.
- Signal Lifespan is increased between 10 to 20 minutes
- Now you don't need to point to the door handle to open it, or close it
- Fixed : Sun light was passing through some of the walls

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32575177/8be6da2b9e55c3c24b8b8f5b0e4511be6bbfea1e.png

Improvements:

- Audio control panel position is changed for better view angle
- New monitor model implementation
- Added new reflection options
- Color correction improvements
- Added outdoor lights
- Interior changes and new models.
- Added start sequence for all the monitors

Changes:

- Coordinate detections system had min and max value that you had to average, now there is a new one that is taking the min and max and average it for you. It is based on only fifteen min and max coordinates, so still won't be 100 % accurate. Still you will have to make some adjustments.
- Removed the terminal like UI. Now it is simplified and shows when needed.
- Signal icon will appear at the top left corner of the screen when signal is available.
- Same icon will appear when you detect a signal and will give you information how much science you have earned.
- Upgrade system UI changes, now it is simpler with more space for future upgrades.
- Upgrade system is documented, so you will know what every sustem upgrade do.
- Increased Antenna range with 100%, now it will be a little easier to detect a signal coordinates

Fixes:
- Fix Artefacts and missing textures using baked light map
- Fix: Visible stars at day time
- Fix: Fog at night was visible and looked like it is emitting light
